items.text: Unfortunately, I tested positive for COVID-19 today. I feel fine and am grateful to be fully vaccinated and twice boosted. I hope everyone stays current on their vaccinations so that, if they are exposed, they too will have milder symptoms.
I’m relieved to hear that @FLOTUS’ symptoms are mild – sending her well wishes and my best as she recovers.

Health care open enrollment begins today! As someone who has not always had access to health care, I know the peace of mind that comes with having affordable health insurance options. Be sure to visit https://t.co/ycvYJsiGD2 to see if you qualify for free or reduced premiums.

Through @POTUS' Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, @Interior is strengthening wildfire resilience efforts and giving wildland firefighters a temporary pay raise and equipping them with health, mental wellness and safety resources. https://t.co/ujNzxZxO2s
Important reminder that open enrollment for health care is available until December 15! Check out https://t.co/ycvYJsjesA to make sure you and your family have the coverage you need.

It was an honor to join @FLOTUS in Bethel, AK to celebrate one of the largest Tribal broadband expansions in the country—all made possible by @POTUS' Investing in America agenda. This investment will ensure communities have access to school, healthcare, and economic opportunity. https://t.co/lm1lBxqM9T

Every student and educator should feel safe and supported, but the challenges facing Native communities can add stress to learning. I'm proud of the @BureauIndianEdu's work to provide services that support their physical, mental and emotional well-being. https://t.co/9OdrMHU2Rn

As a single mom, I pieced together healthcare for my child and me. We got by, but no one should experience that struggle. That’s why I’m grateful for https://t.co/K31BTxRua6, which just opened 2024 enrollment plans. You have until December 15 to get enrolled:

Abandoned coal mines threaten our ecosystems and the health of people and wildlife. With funding from @POTUS' Investing in America agenda, we're cleaning up these toxic sites while creating jobs for the communities impacted the most. https://t.co/DSrMdSha4b

Now more than ever, wildland firefighters need mental health & wellness tools to support their heroic work. @POTUS’ Investing in America agenda helps ensure they have the resources they need to protect our communities while caring for themselves. https://t.co/EcNnmvrUHG

The health of Alaska Native communities and Alaska's complex ecosystem depends on thriving salmon runs. Our Gravel to Gravel Keystone Initiative - informed by local communities - works across the region to restore habitat for abundant salmon.

https://t.co/URvEr1XJT2

As the oldest continuously run federal fish hatchery, Neosho Fish Hatchery plays a key role in our conservation efforts. I was thrilled to see how the @USFWS team is raising native species like sturgeon and freshwater mussels essential to the health of our rivers. https://t.co/TC3Yv4MNGl

Wildland firefighters are a critical line of defense against extreme fires exacerbated by the climate crisis. The Bipartisan Infrastructure Law is delivering the tools firefighters need - from mental health resources to wildfire preparedness.
https://t.co/1NVCsPyhx4

So much life relies on the watersheds that surround our nation’s rivers and streams. With @POTUS’ Investing in America agenda, @USBR is making a coordinated investment in ecosystem health and water supply reliability for Western communities and lands. https://t.co/npIn8II9pr

If you're from the West, you know how critical sagebrush is to wildlife, plants and communities. Through our Sagebrush Keystone Initiative, we're revitalizing this ecosystem for landscape health and longevity for our kids to inherit.

https://t.co/5LslpSwAuy

Caring for the wellbeing of our nation’s federal wildland firefighters is critical. We’re building a Joint Behavioral Health program with @USDAgov to support comprehensive health and wellness for these brave team members. https://t.co/EcNnmvrUHG

It is abundantly clear just how essential the outdoor recreation economy is - for our health, our economy and the viability of our future. I was grateful to join @ORRoundtable to share updates on how @Interior is bolstering this industry nationwide. https://t.co/5WWn4XzKAm

This Great Outdoors Month, we are reminded how critical green space is for our souls, our health & our planet. This week, we're adding 4 new national trails to the National Trails System, enhancing outdoor recreation and connection for local communities. https://t.co/lyCyoQhSEY

From Palau to the Marshall Islands & Micronesia, our @Interior team is administering funding from the recently negotiated Compacts of Free Association that will bolster priorities like public health, education and climate adaptation in these areas for generations to come. https://t.co/hySw36D68d

The investments we make to safeguard local water supplies will have lasting impacts for Americans' health and safety for decades to come. This investment of $55 million from @POTUS' Investing in America agenda will bolster a drought resilient future for Western communities.

To date, our Administration has announced five additions to the National Wildlife Refuge System. That's over half a million acres of land to be managed for ecosystem health and species like the Western monarch butterfly, pronghorn, & Indiana bat. https://t.co/vf70DPzQ85

Mitigating the risk & harm of wildland fire is a critical responsibility for @Interior. Thanks to @POTUS' Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, we're tackling this challenge with investments in firefighter pay, mental health & training, as well as hazardous fuels management & research. https://t.co/ejJ365uKan

It's that time of year again! Voting for Fat Bear Week begins today through October 8. Fat bears indicate the health of @KatmaiNPS - vast public lands that support irreplaceable wildlife. Vote for your favorite and learn more about this stunning place. https://t.co/WRvQmfeh9s https://t.co/yqdtDHHncq

This year, @BLMNational finalized our Public Lands Rule to elevate landscape health and guide the balanced management of America’s public lands. The rule is helping achieve healthier lands, cleaner waters, and a brighter future. https://t.co/pX56UZJ5sR

Indigenous People have influenced much of what we do every day - from food and fashion, to conservation, science and medicine. Indigenous Knowledge, passed down by our ancestors, will help us leave this Earth better for future generations. Happy Indigenous Peoples' Day! https://t.co/oxfSq08u47
